articles.title: Banking rails are moving past the 'stablecoin winner' narrative: Sygnum
articles.snippet: Digital asset bank Sygnum says institutional clients want multiple tokenized cash instruments operating interchangeably on a single platform.

articles.title: MassPay taps Coinbase to expand stablecoin payouts
articles.snippet: MassPay taps Coinbase to add USDC-powered cross-border payouts, betting stablecoin rails will cut costs and speed up settlement for businesses paying globally.

articles.title: Franklin Templeton, BNP Paribas see tokenization boosting EU's capital efficiency
articles.snippet: Executives from Franklin Templeton and BNP Paribas say tokenized assets and stablecoins could improve capital efficiency across Europe as Wall Street expands tokenization efforts.

articles.title: Banks Say Stablecoin Rules Should Cover Secondary Markets
articles.snippet: Banking industry trade groups argue AML rules should focus on higher-risk activity while addressing gaps in stablecoin secondary markets.

articles.title: Tether, Nvidia and Amazon Back Humanoid Robotics Firm NEURA in $1.4 Billion Funding Round
articles.snippet: Stablecoin giant Tether led a massive Series C round for German robotics firm NEURA, which will embed crypto payment tools and edge AI.
